title: Evaluating Large Language Models in High-Stakes Domains: companion code, data and notebooks
description: Code, simulated-data generators, de-identified study data (fifteen language models on fifteen transfusion-medicine vignettes, two administration conditions) and one notebook per chapter for the monograph 'Evaluating Large Language Models in High-Stakes Domains: A Gentle Introduction to Measurement, Uncertainty, and Reliability', a draft prepared for Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning.

creators.name: Costa, Thalles Ferreira
creators.affiliation: Oswaldo Cruz Institute (IOC/Fiocruz), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
